pages.speaker: MOVING_BOX
pages.text: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.

pages.speaker: MOVING_BOX
pages.text:
It's a POKéMON brand moving and
delivery service.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: MOM: RAED, we're here, honey!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
It must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
How do you like it?
This is our new home!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
And, you get your own room, RAED!
Let's go inside.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
MOM: See, RAED?
Isn't it nice in here, too?

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: This is so convenient!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
RAED, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
DAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: Don't forget to set it!

new room?

pages.text: Good! Everything's put away neatly!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
They finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: POKéMON movers are so convenient!

Oh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.

pages.text:
MOM: Oh! RAED, RAED!
Quick! Come quickly!

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!
Maybe DAD will be on!

pages.speaker: INTERVIEWER
pages.text:
INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this
report from in front of PETALBURG GYM.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: MOM: Oh… It's over.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
I think DAD was on, but we missed him.
Too bad.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
Oh, yes.
One of DAD's friends lives in town.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text: PROF. BIRCH is his name.

pages.speaker: MOM
pages.text:
He lives right next door, so you should
go over and introduce yourself.

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text: Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text:
The PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text: Oh, let me explain what fieldwork is.

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text:
It is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text: instead of a laboratory.

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text:
The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text: rather go outside and experience

pages.speaker: SCIENTIST_1
pages.text: things than read about them here.

neighbor! Hi!

pages.speaker: WOMAN_4
pages.text:
We have a daughter about the same
age as you.

pages.speaker: WOMAN_4
pages.text:
Our daughter was excited about making
a new friend.
